method: actual Spark SQL on controlled numerical fixtures; no model calls

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM orders

WITH f AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) AS invoice_frequency FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_frequency>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM f
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM orders
SELECT AVG(total_units) AS value FROM orders
SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS value FROM sales_lines WHERE transaction_type='sale'

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts) AS month,SUM(order_amount) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts)) SELECT (sales-LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month),0) AS value FROM m ORDER BY month
WITH c AS (SELECT country,SUM(order_amount) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY country) SELECT sales / NULLIF(SUM(sales) OVER (),0) AS value FROM c ORDER BY country

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts) AS month,SUM(order_amount) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts)) SELECT SUM(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM m ORDER BY month

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts) AS month,SUM(order_amount) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts)) SELECT AVG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM m ORDER BY month
SELECT PERCENTILE_APPROX(order_amount,0.5,10000) AS value FROM orders
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_high_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM customer_summary WHERE as_of_date=DATE '2011-12-01'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type='cancellation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM sales_lines
SELECT SUM(order_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) FROM orders WHERE 1=0

WITH f AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) AS invoice_frequency FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND 1=0 GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_frequency>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) FROM f

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts) AS month,SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(order_ts)=1 THEN 0 ELSE order_amount END) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',order_ts)) SELECT (sales-LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month),0) FROM m ORDER BY month

columns: ((sales - lag(sales, 1, NULL) OVER (ORDER BY month ASC NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN -1 FOLLOWING AND -1 FOLLOWING)) / nullif(lag(sales, 1, NULL) OVER (ORDER BY month ASC NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN -1 FOLLOWING AND -1 FOLLOWING), 0))
